asr.full_text: So there was a comment from a viewer that I really wanted to have a discussion about. I know a lot of people were definitely disappointed in how ADA performed in this market cycle, Despite some of the major news that we've been seeing. And it's the reason why is, We have been trapped in ... Not an ADA bear market but an altcoin bear market Since the height of the prior market cycle. And I want to show you guys exactly what I mean. Sometimes we need to go outside of the chamber, we need to go on a bit of a trip and i want to show you something else that actually should give you a lot of confidence so far headed through this bear market cycle so if you're new or haven't already share your support for the channel down below make sure you hit that subscribe button that bell it's free to do it'll keep you updated anytime there's new content live here on the channel So I think we can all agree that you know, this cycles performance for a da was very disappointing We expected some exciting highs that just unfortunately never materialized in the big reason why is When we look at the people that are that are in this space many of them have looked at Carnot Oh have looked at a ta Historically speaking and kind of you know, turn their nose up at it In this space, many of them have looked at Cardano have looked at Ada. Historically speaking and kind of, you know, turned their nose up at it. Some of it had to do with the lack of a major stable coin. Some of it had to do with network performance, whatever it might be. And many people did not move new capital into into Ada, except for people that were already here in the ecosystem, except for people that were speculators. That is what allowed AIDA to move and do well in this market cycle. I think obviously, from $0.22 to $1.32, I don't think that's a small move, or $1.22, whatever it was. I don't think that... No, $32. I don't think that's a small move by any means, but it's definitely a disappointing move compared to the prior all time high. And actually, I saw this this comment reason i started talking about ada before i even owned any um as i've done with many assets before uh and what he's said specifically this comment just just further down here is that ada has been in its own bear market since 2021 and people need to understand that that's completely incorrect if we look around the space if we go on a little trip you guys can see that link chain link which has had major mass massive integrations throughout this market cycle did not set a new all-time high stellar as xlm it's been around for a very long period of time did not hit an all-time high of the cycle uh h-bar which obviously i cover here on the channel frequently now irregularly big announcements big integrations big enterprise adoption doesn't mean a is bad. It doesn't mean Cardano is bad. It just means that we're trapped in an altcoin bear market. The biggest thing I've used to show this before, is if we look at the total three minus USDT and what you might notice here is that we did not see an altcoin expansion, we did not see this hit a new, all-time high. So if we look at that data here, it's just some sort of, or if we look at, um, a large market that's at this level and that's it this time the, is if we look at the total three minus usdt and what you might notice here is that we did not see an all-coin expansion we did not see this hit a new all-time high and it's because you did not see new users entering the space it's the same people the same money the same this is not this was not a normal bull market all right adoption basically flatlining in 2022 is what hurt us in this cycle now some things have changed however which is a very promising sign for ada and others so i want to show you guys i had to go through and do all the the data on this but what we've seen which has with market cycles in the past is the deeper you get into a market cycle, you tend to see more capital concentrated at the top. For example, the prior market cycle, we actually saw, I think it was a 91% of capital in the market cap in crypto was in the top 100 assets. That was the bear market. And it rose all the way up to like 90 i think it was 98 or so and the height of the prior bull market fast forward to this last market cycle got down to 95 percent uh concentrated in the top 100 assets in the prior bear market cycle to 99 here at the height of this this bull market cycle that just went through. It was actually 99.63%. So what tends to happen is you watch this ebb and flow in terms of capital in the space. And as you fall into a bear market, you tend to watch — watch — watch—wow, I can't speak! You tend to watch the capital start to move out into the rest of the crypto market as it looks for opportunity, as it looks for new launches, right? And what we've actually seen so far is that concentration of market cap still remains at 98.8%. The reason why this is good for ADA is capital is venturing less from the larger blue chip assets. And it's remaining at the top longer. And what that shows you is that you're starting to see a more mature class of holder in the crypto market. And you're starting to see a more mature market in general. Now, obviously, because BTC has gotten so large and it's been so dominated by institutions, same with some other assets, Ethereum, et cetera, it's going to linger around the top longer. But then again, this is where you start to see that shift towards more utility driven assets where people start focusing on those who have the biggest announcement, the largest traction. And obviously we just had the midnight launch. We just had USDCX come to Cardano. There's a lot of big things taking place right now that like I talked about earlier, are opening eyes that are really accelerating Ada's opportunity to perform well. And I want to remind everybody that just because you did not set an all-time high in this last cycle, doesn't mean you can't do it. Perfect example of that is, uh, XRP and there are others as well. And I'm not going to take the time to go back and look at this, but the point I'm trying to make is people are making weird judgments based on something that many other assets in the crypto space went through um unfortunately many people are stuck in the echo chamber they just focus on ada they think ada's the only thing and that it just kind of you know it's kind of out on its own lost island somewhere now we're a chain of islands if this is a horrible analogy but we're a chain of islands all stuck in the same ocean right now all All waiting for that help to come if you will. And that will come over time. You will see adoption increase. You will see things get better in crypto in the long run. But this is why patience is important. This has definitely been the hardest market cycle for the people in crypto because you didn't see the euphoria that you've seen historically speaking. You did not see the new users enter crypto. But that push is going to come come so i wanted to share that with you guys i appreciate as always let me know your thoughts below have a great day catch you in the next one
